name: @openshapeforge/admin
//port: http://localhost:3002/* as the ONLY app redirect URI for the
openshapeforge-admin-gateway client, so a different port does not produce a
misconfigured app — it produces a Keycloak `invalid_redirect_uri` at the
moment of sign-in. Changing it means changing authorization.control.yaml
Deliberately NOT apps/web's 3000: the two apps are different audiences on
different realms and must not share an origin.

scripts.//deps: @openshapeforge/auth resolves to dist/ under a bundler (see its package.json), so build it before Next reads it. Same as apps/web.

//dependencies: Deliberately a SUBSET of apps/web's, at identical versions, and nothing
that is not already somewhere in the workspace. Adding the app must not
add a package to the dependency tree, because that would move
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and turn a skeleton into a supply-chain change.
ioredis is here for the same reason apps/web has it: the session payload
lives in Redis and only its opaque id goes in the cookie.
